notes: The workflow plugin carries no specialists of its own -- it ships skills, scripts and session hooks, so its extensions array is empty by construction rather than unfilled. This repo consumes itself (see CLAUDE.md); through the github source it sees the most recently pushed version, not ongoing branch work. Inventory brought to 19 on 2026-07-29 -- the full roster, matching the enabled plugin exactly. Six were added: 02-09, 03-02, 04-11, 04-12, 04-13, 06-30, whose lenses landed with the adopt-the-six change (PR #212) while this register was not updated alongside. That gap is why an inventory drift can sit unnoticed in the register of the very repo that owns the check: 'exists in the consumer but is not in the register' is an [INFO], and the session hook reports only [ERROR] lines, so nothing surfaced it at session start. It took a deliberate run of check-connectors.ps1 to find. Whoever lands lenses here updates this array in the same change. CAUGHT UP 2026-09-05 (#1465): the workflow plugin's id moved from 'contributing-davekjohn@' to 'dkj-policy@' (source issue #1437, commit 17149edb) and this record held the retired name. Measured in this checkout rather than taken from the report: .claude/settings.json enables dkj-policy@claude-code-specialists, and installed_plugins.json carries a project-scope record for THIS checkout under that id (4.30.0, commit ba889a81) and none at all under the retired one. The empty extensions array is unchanged and is still the measured answer, not an unfilled one: plugins/workflows/dkj-policy/ ships no agents/ (its folder holds blueprint/, hooks/, scripts/, skills/, templates/ and the portable docs). WHAT THE RETIRED NAME COST HERE is precisely what connectors/xoxowildhearts.json recorded for the #886 rename: check-connectors reports an id the marketplace no longer declares as an [INFO] and then SKIPS the whole plugin block, so for this repo's own entry nothing about the workflow plugin was version-checked -- not enabled-in-settings, not extensions, not the machine version. 'The class was never emptied, only its instance was' held a second time: #1437 re-opened the same blind spot by the identical route, and it did so in the register of the repo that OWNS the check. The [INFO] deliberately stays an [INFO] -- making it an error re-opens the four false alarms of August 9, 2026 -- so a consumer catching up IS the repair, and it is the consumer's move rather than the check's. The five other manifests still naming contributing-davekjohn@ are left standing and are correct as they are: the register records what a consumer HAS, and each catches up when it migrates. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952. ONE STALE COUNT WAS DROPPED from the opening sentence in the same change: it said 'two session hooks' where the plugin ships five SessionStart hooks and one Stop hook. It is not restated as a number -- that same count went stale twice inside two days on CLAUDE.md's own roster page, which is why that page stopped listing the set at all, and each plugin's hooks/hooks.json is the one place that cannot go stale. CAUGHT UP 2026-09-06 (#1525): the core team's id moved from 'team-alpha@' to 'dkj-team-alpha@' and this record held the retired name -- the OTHER half of the very file the entry above repaired. Measured in this checkout rather than taken from the report: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json declares 'dkj-team-alpha' and no 'team-alpha'; .claude/settings.json at HEAD enables dkj-team-alpha@claude-code-specialists; and installed_plugins.json carries a project-scope record for THIS checkout under that id (4.31.0, commit 5958e52e) beside a stale pre-migration one under the retired id (4.30.0, commit ba889a81). The 19 extensions were RE-READ rather than carried over, because a skipped block had never verified them: the plugin owns exactly 19 ids (15 in agents/, 4 in personas/) and .claude/specialists/lenses/ holds a lens for each, so the array is the measured answer and is unchanged. WHAT THE RETIRED NAME COST HERE is the same skipped block described above, now for the core team: enabled-in-settings, the 19 extensions and the machine version were none of them checked. THE SHARPER HALF IS THE INVERSION. The [INFO] said this repo 'has not migrated to the current names yet' and that the record was 'Correct as it stands' -- both false in the same checkout the script was reading, because settings.json proves the migration two directories away. A doctrine written for a consumer that has NOT moved reads as absolution for one that HAS, so this entry could sit wrong indefinitely while its own check called it right. 'The class was never emptied, only its instance was' therefore held a THIRD time, and this time inside the commit that wrote the sentence: 011a32ef (#1465) changed the workflow plugin's id and left the core team's standing, one block above it. The lesson recorded here is that a rename is checked against EVERY id in a manifest, not against the id the report happened to name. The check is unchanged and the [INFO] deliberately stays an [INFO], for the reason given above; the other manifests naming retired ids are left standing and are still correct as they are, because those consumers have not migrated. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952. CAUGHT UP 2026-09-10 (#1698): the core team's id moved from 'dkj-team-alpha@' to 'dkj-subagents-alpha@' in the 4.33.0 rename and this record held the retired name -- the fourth rename to reach this file by that route, after #886, #1437 and #1525. AND THE SAME PASS REGISTERED FOUR PLUGINS THIS RECORD HAD NEVER LISTED AT ALL: dkj-subagents-ecomm@, dkj-subagents-lifehub@, dkj-subagents-shopify@ and dkj-policy-bwj@. Measured in this checkout rather than taken from a report: .claude/settings.json enables all six, which is CLAUDE.md's own rule ('it enables EVERY plugin in the marketplace', Dave, 2026-09-08); installed_plugins.json carries a project-scope record for THIS checkout under each of the six at v4.33.0; and the marketplace clone declares exactly those six names and no dkj-team-* any more. The extension inventories were counted from the clone's own payload rather than carried over: alpha ships 15 subagents/ + 4 personas/ = 19 (unchanged), ecomm 3 (06-26, 06-27, 06-28), lifehub 5 (02-10, 03-08, 03-14, 04-03, 04-04), shopify 3 (04-20, 05-21, 05-22) -- 30 in total, and .claude/specialists/lenses/ holds exactly 30 files, one per id, so every array here is the measured answer. dkj-policy@ and dkj-policy-bwj@ ship no agents at all, so their empty arrays are by construction and not unfilled -- the same answer, and the same wording, as the 2026-09-05 entry above. WHAT THE TWO GAPS COST IS ONE COST REACHED BY TWO ROUTES: check-connectors reports an unresolvable id as an [INFO] and then SKIPS that plugin's whole block, while a plugin absent from this array is never looped over at all -- so on 2026-09-10, in the register of the repo that OWNS the check, five of this consumer's six plugins sat outside the version check (one skipped as unresolvable, four never listed) and dkj-policy@ was the only one checked. THE SHARPER HALF IS THAT THE SECOND ROUTE IS SILENT. The 2026-08-21 note in connectors/xoxowildhearts.json measured the enabled-but-unregistered case as 'the ONLY enabled-but-unregistered plugin anywhere' and concluded that registering it 'empties the class'; it also recorded, deliberately, that the plugin level prints no [INVENTORY] line where the lens level does, on the ground that 'a risk whose population is now zero is written down rather than fixed'. That population stopped being zero on 2026-09-08, when this repo enabled the three add-on teams and dkj-policy-bwj, and nothing said so -- an [INFO] at least prints a line, and an unregistered plugin has no block to skip and therefore prints nothing at all. So the reason for leaving that asymmetry standing has expired, and it is filed as #1775 rather than repaired here: this branch corrected data, not the checker. NOT MEASURED IN THIS PASS: whether any other consumer's record carries the same unregistered-plugin gap, and nothing else this record holds -- not the drift figures, not the other manifests. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952. MIGRATED 2026-09-10 (#1769), and this is the ONE manifest allowed to move ahead of the flag day. The marketplace itself is renamed from 'claude-code-specialists' to 'dkj-claude-plugins', so all six ids and the 'repo' field follow it, and the file itself was renamed from connectors/claude-code-specialists.json to connectors/dkj-claude-plugins.json, which tracks the repo slug. WHY THIS IS NOT THE FALSE ALARM THE DOCTRINE FORBIDS: the rule in connectors/README.md writes a renamed id only after the consumer itself has migrated, because this register records what a consumer HAS rather than what it is expected to have next. Here the consumer IS this repo, and its migration is the very commit that carries this line -- .claude/settings.json on this branch enables all six as <plugin>@dkj-claude-plugins -- so the record and the reality it describes move together instead of one claiming the other. For every OTHER consumer decision A (Dave, 2026-09-10) stands unchanged: their records migrate on the flag day, alongside their own PRs. WHAT LEAVING IT BEHIND COST, measured on this branch before this change: connectors.tests.ps1 case 6 ('self-manifest (workshop consumes itself): exit code 0') failed, because the settings chain said @dkj-claude-plugins while this record still said @claude-code-specialists -- exactly the disagreement the check exists to report, and correct behaviour rather than a defect. open-pr.ps1 blocks on a failing suite, so the alternative was opening the flag-day PR with -SkipTests, i.e. the test gate switched off on the largest merge this repo has ever made. Dave's word, 2026-09-10: amend decision A for the self-connector alone rather than skip the gate. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY STILL WRONG HERE UNTIL THE FLAG DAY: installed_plugins.json on this machine carries all six records under the OLD marketplace name, because the re-install is a flag-day step (#1802) -- so a version check run from this checkout before that re-install reads this record's ids as not installed here, and that is the truth about the machine rather than a fault in this file. NOT MEASURED IN THIS PASS: the extension inventories, the machine versions and the drift figures -- all unchanged from the 2026-09-10 (#1698) entry above and none of them re-read here. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952. REDUCED 2026-09-30 (Dave): the three add-on teams -- dkj-subagents-ecomm@, dkj-subagents-lifehub@ and dkj-subagents-shopify@ -- are set to false in .claude/settings.json, reversing the 2026-09-08 decision to enable every plugin in the marketplace here, because none of the three has work in this repo and together they cost every session here roughly 2.9k tokens. Their three blocks are removed from this record in the same change, because the register records what this consumer HAS: left standing, check 2 reports each as not enabled and connectors.tests.ps1 case 6 (the self-manifest) fails. Their 11 empty VUL-IN lenses and roster rows go in the same change, so the lens-present-but-unregistered check has nothing to find. They are set to false rather than deleted from settings.json, because a user-scope ~/.claude/settings.json can enable one of them and the last layer that names a plugin wins. The sentences above keep the facts they were WRITTEN with, per #952 -- including the enables-all-six claim, which was true on each date it names.
